Name: Natasha Malpani
Bio: Natasha Malpani is a Founder and Distinguished Trustee of Plaksha University. Natasha is the Founder of Boundless Ventures. After studying Immunology at the University of Oxford, Natasha was a founding team member at Big Society Capital, a USD 1 billion fund in London. She completed her MBA at Stanford University, where she focused on design thinking and innovation. Since then, Natasha has worked for Pocket Aces and founded Boundless Media, an award-winning content studio. In her current role, she combines her investing and creative background by partnering with great founders at an early stage.
Education: MBA, Stanford University | MPhil, University of Cambridge | MSc, University of Oxford
